overviewParagraphs: BRG King's Island Golf Resort is an expansive and tranquil 54-hole golf complex situated on the shores of the Dong Mo reservoir, roughly an hour from Hanoi. Access to the island resort is uniquely via a short, scenic speedboat ride, immediately setting a serene tone for the day.

The resort offers three distinct layouts. The Lakeside Course, designed by Robert McFarland, weaves tightly along the water's edge, bringing the lake into play on 14 holes. The Mountainview Course, crafted by Pacific Coast Design, offers a breathtaking backdrop of the Ba Vi Mountains and features wide fairways flanked by mature forests. The newest addition, the King's Course by Jack Nicklaus II, presents a formidable modern championship test, culminating in a spectacular par-3 19th hole featuring an island green.
With its combination of accessibility, world-class design variety, and profound tranquility, King's Island is an essential stop for any Northern Vietnam golf itinerary.

curatorBriefHtml: BRG Kings Island Golf Resort is Northern Vietnam’s original 54-hole championship complex, set on Dong Mo Lake roughly 45–60 minutes west of central Hanoi. Unlike newer single-loop clubs around the capital, Kings Island lets touring groups play three genuinely different architectural tests across one venue: the classic water-lined Lakeside Course (6,516 yds Blue), the valley-framed Mountainview Course (7,000 yds), and Jack Nicklaus II’s modern Kings Course (7,310 yds), capped by its famous 19th-hole island par 3 hit from a waterfall tee.

Having played Kings Island personally, the standout logistical nuance is choosing the right loop for your group’s handicap and schedule. The newer Kings Course offers the strongest championship conditioning and dramatic back-nine elevation changes, while Mountainview provides generous landing zones framed by the Ba Vi peaks. Access to the original Lakeside clubhouse historically involved a short boat crossing across Dong Mo Lake, adding a memorable sense of arrival away from Hanoi’s urban bustle.

For a Hanoi golf itinerary, we pair Kings Island with Sky Lake or Thanh Lanh Valley, dispatching private touring vehicles at 06:45 AM from the Old Quarter to beat ring-road traffic and finish in time for late-afternoon dining in Hanoi.

scorecard.verdict: Accessible exclusively by speed-boat across Dong Mo Lake, Kings Island is legendary in Northern Vietnam. The Jack Nicklaus II Kings Course brings world-class bunkering and modern design to an iconic island retreat.

faqs.q: Which of the three 18-hole courses at BRG Kings Island should visiting groups prioritize?
faqs.a: If you only have time for one round, prioritize the Jack Nicklaus II-designed Kings Course (opened 2018) for its modern championship greens, dramatic back-nine mountain backdrop, and signature 19th island hole. Groups booking a 36-hole day typically pair Kings Course in the morning with Mountainview in the afternoon.

faqs.q: How far is BRG Kings Island from central Hanoi and Noi Bai Airport?
faqs.a: Allow 50 to 65 minutes by private touring vehicle from central Hanoi (Hoan Kiem / Old Quarter) depending on morning traffic, or roughly 60 minutes from Noi Bai International Airport (HAN). AGS schedules early departures so your group reaches the practice range smoothly before tee-off.

faqs.q: What is the best time of year to play BRG Kings Island?
faqs.a: October through April is prime golf season in Northern Vietnam, bringing crisp 18–26°C daytime temperatures and firm fairways. May through September is hotter and more humid, when early 06:30–07:30 AM tee times are essential.

faqs.q: Are caddies and motorized carts included when booking through AGS?
faqs.a: Yes. Every AGS round at BRG Kings Island includes your 18-hole green fee, dedicated 1-on-1 club caddie, shared motorized cart, and private door-to-door transfers from your Hanoi hotel.
